Marta Lin: Hey team — quick roll call for Priya Kumar's onsite panel next Tue (11am PT). Can folks confirm availability?
Ryan Cho: I can make 11am PT, will need 15 mins buffer after.
Samir Patel: I'm in but can only do 11:00-12:00 PT.
Elena Gomez: I have a conflict 11:00-11:30, free after 11:30 — can swap with Ryan for buffer?
Marta Lin: @Ryan can you start at 11:15 instead? Candidate schedule is tight.
Ryan Cho: Yep I can do 11:15 start if Samir is OK with moving 15m later.
Samir Patel: That's fine, 11:15 works.
people-ops-bot: calendar update: Priya Kumar — Panel (Marta, Ryan, Samir, Elena) — Tue 11:15 PT added to team calendar.
Marta Lin: Thanks. Quick second ask: who will own the debrief notes and score capture? We usually use the debrief doc and the rubric matrix.
Elena Gomez: I can own the debrief doc and send a link pre-panel.
Ryan Cho: I'll take the rubric scoring sheet during the interview.
Marta Lin: Great. Please remind everyone to leave 2–3 bullet highlights and a score (1–5) in the sheet within 2 hours post-interview.
Samir Patel: Noted. Also small rubric clarification: for 'system design' are we scoring on architecture depth or tradeoff discussion? I've seen different interpretations.
Marta Lin: Good call. Rubric guidance: focus on tradeoffs & measurable impact first, architecture depth as supporting evidence. So score higher for clear tradeoff reasoning even if sketchy diagrams. I'll paste short note to the rubric.
Marta Lin: ```Rubric note:
- System design: prioritize tradeoff reasoning (latency/cost/complexity)
- Communication: clarity and ability to surface unknowns
- Ownership: past examples and measurable impact```
Elena Gomez: Perfect, I'll add that to the doc header.
Ryan Cho: Quick ops question — is there a standard template link to paste in the calendar invite? I always forget the debrief doc URL.
people-ops-bot: template links: Interview debrief doc — https://docs.redwood.ai/templates/debrief; Rubric matrix — https://docs.redwood.ai/templates/rubric-matrix
Marta Lin: Thanks bot. Final note: please do short pre-read in the doc (1–2 bullets) if you had any prior interactions with Priya. Saves time in the loopback.
Samir Patel: Will add my pre-read now (worked with Priya on the ML infra team a year ago).
Elena Gomez: I'll post the debrief doc link in the panel thread 24h before.
Marta Lin: Awesome — team, set a reminder for 2 hours post-interview to add scores. :alarm_clock:
Ryan Cho: Done.
people-ops-bot: reminder scheduled: add debrief scores — 2h after Tue 11:15 PT.
